<thought>To determine the number of aromatic carbon atoms, I will first obtain the 13C NMR spectrum of the sample using the carbon_nmr_spectra tool. Then I will retrieve typical carbon chemical shift ranges for aromatic carbons with retrieve_carbon_shifts. By comparing the peaks in the spectrum to the aromatic range, I can count how many aromatic carbons are present and provide the integer answer.</thought>
<action>carbon_nmr_spectra</action>
